tagline: Video-based environmental certification for organizations and corporate teams.

hero.headline: Certify Your Teams for Planetary Stewardship
hero.description: Deploy branded video curricula across your organization. Track completion, issue verifiable certificates, and align staff with the ANABEE 7 Pillars framework.

features.title: Fully Customizable

orgSteps.title: Certification
